OP_PUSH65.btc

The first opcode in Bitcoin's Genesis Block.
0x41 — pushed Satoshi's 65-byte public key onto the stack.

Without it, OP_CHECKSIG cannot verify.
Without it, the first 50 BTC cannot be locked.

17 years. Zero failures.
Native. Irreplaceable.
